title: Highly sensitive Poliovirus RT-PCR - Environmental Samples
author: Alison Tedcastle
materials: DreamTaq Hot Start PCR Master Mix

steps.title: Clean bench for RNA work
steps.instruction: Wipe down lab bench surfaces and pipettes with 70 % ethanol and an RNase‑degrading agent (e.g., RNase Zap).

steps.title: Prepare first‑round RT‑PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Using Superscript III One‑Step RT‑PCR System with Platinum Taq High Fidelity, combine the reagents for primer set Y7R/AriR and nOPV2_MMR as specified in the reaction tables; prepare enough master mix for all samples plus positive and negative controls and add 10 % extra volume for pipetting loss. Use RNA immediately after extraction; avoid freeze‑thaw cycles. Test each sample in triplicate.

steps.title: Aliquot first‑round master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the master mix briefly, spin down, and dispense 16 µL of master mix into each PCR tube or strip.

steps.title: Add template and controls
steps.instruction: To each tube add either 4 µL positive control or 8 µL extracted RNA sample; for the negative control add 8 µL nuclease‑free water. Close lids and move the rack to the template‑addition area.

steps.title: Run reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermocycler and incubate at 50 °C for 30 minutes. After the incubation spin down briefly.

steps.title: Add forward primer
steps.instruction: After the RT step, spin the tubes and add 1 µL forward primer to each reaction.

steps.title: Run first‑round PCR
steps.instruction: Transfer the tubes to the PCR room and run the specified cycling conditions for the first‑round amplification (as detailed in the protocol).

steps.title: Store first‑round PCR products
steps.instruction: Optionally store the completed first‑round PCR products at –20 °C; they may be kept indefinitely, but it is recommended to continue the protocol promptly.

steps.title: Clean bench for DNA work
steps.instruction: Wipe down lab bench surfaces and pipettes with 70 % ethanol and a DNase‑degrading agent (e.g., DNase Zap).

steps.title: Prepare second‑round PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Using DreamTaq Hot Start PCR Master Mix, assemble the master mix for primer sets Y7/Q8 and PV1_VP1 + Sabin primers/Q8 as described in the reaction tables; include all samples, positive and negative controls and add 10 % extra volume for pipetting loss.

steps.title: Aliquot second‑round master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the master mix briefly, spin down, and dispense 23 µL of master mix into each PCR tube or strip.

steps.title: Add diluted first‑round product
steps.instruction: Dilute the first‑round PCR product 1:10 with nuclease‑free water; add 2 µL of this dilution to the appropriate second‑round reaction tubes. For the negative control add 2 µL nuclease‑free water. Close lids and move the rack to the template‑addition area.

steps.title: Run second‑round PCR
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermocycler and run the target‑specific cycling conditions as provided in the protocol.

steps.title: Check amplicons by gel
steps.instruction: Load all second‑round PCR reactions, including positive and negative controls, onto a 1 % agarose gel; visualize bands and compare to the expected sizes listed in Appendix 1. Proceed only with reactions that show the correct positive band.

steps.title: Pool amplicons
steps.instruction: For each virus sample pool 7 µL from each triplicate amplicon; if only two positive reactions are present pool 10 µL each; if a single positive reaction is present pool 20 µL. (Alternatively, purify and quantify each amplicon individually for equimolar pooling.)

steps.title: Purify pooled amplicons with AMPure beads

substeps.instruction: Warm AMPure beads to room temperature; add an equal volume of beads to each pooled sample (e.g., 21 µL beads to 21 µL pooled DNA).
Mix gently by pipetting and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack until the solution is clear; pipette off the supernatant.
While on the magnet, wash beads with 100 µL 80 % ethanol; discard the ethanol.
Spin briefly, return tubes to the magnet, and let any residual ethanol drain; air‑dry beads for ~30 seconds.
Remove tubes from the magnet and resuspend beads in 20 µL nuclease‑free water; incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place tubes back on the magnet, allow beads to pellet, and transfer up to 20 µL of the eluate to a clean tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit Broad Range dsDNA kit:

substeps.instruction: Prepare a Qubit assay master mix: for each sample (and two standards) combine 199 µL buffer with 1 µL Qubit reagent to a total of 200 µL; add 10 % extra volume.
For each standard add 190 µL of the master mix to 10 µL standard; for each sample add 198 µL master mix to 2 µL purified DNA.
Vortex each tube once, incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature, and measure fluorescence using the Qubit with the Broad Range kit selected.
Record the DNA concentration for each sample.

steps.title: Normalize DNA to 200 fmol
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 fmol of each purified DNA sample into a clean 96‑well plate; add nuclease‑free water to bring the final volume to 12.5 µL (mix gently by pipetting). Example: 200 fmol of a 900 bp fragment ≈ 110 ng.

steps.title: Proceed to nanopore barcoding
steps.instruction: Continue with step 5 of the native barcoding protocol for direct‑detection nanopore sequencing (see https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e6nvwjko9lmk/v1).
